title: La cerveza del viernes
goal: Drink with workmates and keep up with the joking
culture: Paying is fought over rather than negotiated, and losing gracefully is part of it. Ya va la última is said about the third of six and everybody knows it is not true, which is why saying it is joining in rather than lying.

beats.good: Una fría — a cold one. Nobody orders beer by its name; the temperature is the part that matters.
Yo invito — my treat. It is fought over rather than negotiated, and losing the fight gracefully is part of the ritual.

beats.objective: Push back the way he would
beats.good: No seás así — don’t be like that. VOS: seás, not seas. It is the same phrase doña Chepa used about the gossip, in the vos form because he is your friend.

beats.es: Bueno, bueno. Ya va la última, ¿va?
beats.objective: Agree it is the last one
beats.good: Ya va la última is said about the third of six and everybody at the table knows it. Saying it is joining in, not lying.
